newsitem.title: USA: TV Star Ellen DeGeneres comes out of the closet.
newsitem.headline: TV Star Ellen DeGeneres comes out of the closet.

text.p: Ellen DeGeneres, the comedienne and star of the hit TV show "Ellen," has admitted to being gay, and said her admission was "the most freeing experience," Time magazine reported on Sunday.

"When I decided to have my character on the show come out, I knew I was going to have to come out too," DeGeneres told Time. Her character Ellen Morgan is due to come out on the April 30 episode of the show, Time says in its latest issue due out on Monday.
DeGeneres, 39, said the decision to reveal her sexuality was the culmination of a long process, confronting her fears about being rejected as well as her wish to lead a more honest and open life.

"I always thought I could keep my personal life separate from my professional life. I mean, I really tried to figure out every way to avoid answering that question for as long as I could," the actress said.
"Now I feel completely comfortable with myself and I don't have to be fearful about something damaging my career if it gets out, because now I'm in control of it -- sort of.
